cooked:
Hello again @dlnraja
Additionally, I’ve noticed that the Homey app is running slower within Advanced Flows. When I move a card, there is a noticeable lag, and the presence sensor cards seem to continuously disappear and reload.

I tried uninstalling the most recent apps I installed, but the issue persists. Because of this, I suspect it might be related to the latest updates for ‘Universal Tuya’ and that continuous refreshing required for the sensor to detect properly.

I also tried disabling the app (without uninstalling it), but I haven’t been able to resolve the lagging issue.

Best regards
